note: Madison County Conservation Board park (one of Iowa's first state parks, county-run since 1989), 4 miles southwest of Winterset on the Middle River. The campground and two yurt cabins sit on the open 'backbone' ridge, well above and away from the river. The main (north) entrance goes through the Harmon Tunnel, 12 ft 6 in clearance with a fairly tight turn at its east end; the county's alternate route from US 169 via Carver Trail and Pammel Park Trail enters by the south gates and avoids it. --Claude
summary: Fees changed $17 -> $22-24 (county page and booking contract; the $17 / $5 fee text on mycountyparks is stale), reservation fee $5 -> $2. Booking filled: 1-year window, 2 days ahead, 2-night minimum on reservations, self-registration otherwise. 36 RV sites (stored 41 counted the tent sites), 50A + water, facilities, season first weekend of April to last weekend of October. Tunnel 12'6" passes EKKO; south-gate route avoids it. Not waterfront confirmed. Pin fine.
flags: FEES (changed 17 -> 22/24): the county's own camping page gives $22 self-registered, $24 online plus a $2 website transaction fee, and the booking contract on mycountyparks says 'the nightly fee for sites 1 through 36 is $22' (booking page shows '$0 - 24 /Night'). The stored $17 and $5 reservation fee came from mycountyparks' Camping activity text, which still says so and is stale.

ACCESS (passes): the main entrance runs through the Harmon Tunnel, 'a tunnel with a 12′ 6″ clearance and a fairly tight turn on the east end of the tunnel'; EKKO is under 10.5 ft, and the county gives an alternate route to the south gates for anyone who'd rather avoid it. The Middle River ford is on the Lodge road, not on either route to the campground (park map). Worth a note line, which the proposed note carries.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. Both loops are on the open backbone ridge (NAIP), with the Middle River down off the ridge behind timber; no site is by the river.

SITES: stored count 41 included the five tent-only sites; 36 is the RV pad count. No pad lengths published (rock-surfaced pads, head-in parking barred unless the tow vehicle stays attached); RVs of all sizes visible on imagery. No fit caveat needed.

WEBSITE: the stored first line (mycountyparks .../facility/pammel-park-campground) loads, but it is a generic 'Pammel Park Campground' facility page with no rates or availability; bookings go through the per-site 'Pammel Park Campground Site NN' facilities. Suggest the county's camping page https://www.madisoncountyparks.org/camping-yurtcabins/pammel-park-camping/ in place of the park page as the second line. apply.py does not write website.
